Every parameter is a row of the data list's MIDI parameter change tables, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Parameter change: F0 43 1n 7F 11 <address> <data> F7, n the device number (the deviceId variable is 1n, 10H for device number 1); bulk dumps are asked for with 2n and answered with 0n, both taken as device number 1.
Identity: the reply the data list prints, F0 7E 7F 06 02 43 00 41 40 06 00 00 00 7F F7.

The CP5/CP50 data list prints the model ID as 7F and a second byte for each model (10 for the CP5, 11 for the CP50), and the identity's family code likewise (3F 06, 40 06): this profile takes this model's.

parameters.name: Master Tune
parameters.description: 4 bytes: 1st bit 3-0: bit 15-12 2nd bit 3-0: bit 11-8 3rd bit 3-0: bit 7-4 4th bit 3-0: bit 3-0. Printed: -102.4 – +102.3 [cent].

parameters.name: Performance Name
parameters.description: 10 characters, one per address from 30 00 00, 32 – 126 (ASCII). Read from the bulk dump; not written, since a parameter change carries one character.

parameters.name: Assignable Knob1 FxBlock
parameters.description: Printed: off, pianoL 1, preAmpL 1, modFxL 1, powAmpL 1, .., pianoR 2, preAmpR 2, modFxR 2, powAmpR 2, Reverb.

parameters.name: Assignable Knob 2 FxBlock
parameters.description: Printed: off, pianoL 1, preAmpL 1, modFxL 1, powAmpL 1, .., pianoR 2, preAmpR 2, modFxR 2, powAmpR 2, Reverb.

parameters.name: Assignable Knob 3 FxBlock
parameters.description: Printed: off, pianoL 1, preAmpL 1, modFxL 1, powAmpL 1, .., pianoR 2, preAmpR 2, modFxR 2, powAmpR 2, Reverb.

parameters.name: Wave File Name
parameters.description: 8 characters, one per address from 30 04 08, 32 – 126 (ASCII). Read from the bulk dump; not written, since a parameter change carries one character.

parameters.name: Detune MSB Detune LSB
parameters.description: 2 bytes: 1st bit 3-0: bit 7-4, 2nd bit 3-0: bit 3-0. Printed: -12.8 – +12.7 [Hz].

parameters.name: Detune MSB Detune LSB
parameters.description: 2 bytes: 1st bit 3-0: bit 7-4, 2nd bit 3-0: bit 3-0. Printed: -12.8 – +12.7 [Hz].
